gen-gf-langar-author: Langar draws every stroke at a single width, stem to serif, with no swelling anywhere. Author is the opposite in temperament, and its gentle thick-thin shifts give a text serif a dignified, comfortable pace in small doses.
gen-gf-langar-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Wide, rounded, loose-limbed letters with real presence, led by Langar's unvarying strokes over a slow, curvy body. Their strongest quality is that stretched, leisurely stride.
gen-gf-langar-gf-hepta-slab: Langar stands out for strokes that never thicken or thin between stem and serif, loud and expressive. Hepta Slab follows with open, stretched-out words, so a long passage would settle into a bookish, unhurried walk.
gen-gf-langar-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Chunky, expressive strokes up top, then a text serif whose wide-mouthed c and spread-out glyphs loosen everything. Give Padyakke Expanded One generous size to stretch.
gen-gf-lemon-gf-graduate: Lemon's almost circular c, with its slim split, and a lowercase barely shorter than the capitals make for a bold, distinctive heading. Graduate takes over below, spacing its letters generously and holding one pen-tip line, so the headline's punch meets a bookish, dignified text.
gen-gf-lemonada-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab reads with a visibly gaping c and tall, rounded lowercase, classic and dignified in feel. And Lemonada does the opposite job, hammering out an uninterrupted line on every letter while the body handles the quieter reading.
gen-gf-lemonada-gf-fauna-one: Dignified and literary, Fauna One has a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and a generous entry into the e, set under Lemonada's flat, sign-painter weight. A long passage would feel unhurried.
gen-gf-lemonada-gf-glegoo: Lemonada brings a pen line that holds one width throughout, tightly stacked and commanding at the top. Its strongest quality is the gap between that flat insistence and Glegoo's big, open curves.
gen-gf-lemonada-gf-graduate: Graduate reads with generous white between letters and capitals barely taller than lowercase, bookish and dignified. And Lemonada sits above it in a flat, uninterrupted line, so the heading feels tight while the text breathes.
gen-gf-lemonada-gf-hanuman: Lemonada draws its monoline letters tight and upright, with little ascender poking up and spacing like a wide comb. Hanuman answers beneath with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set s terminals, a traditional, refined counterweight.
